item.title: Production Multi-VLAN Network Segmentation & Threat Isolation

item.title: Multi-Node Hypervisor Fabric & Hardware-Accelerated Storage Cluster
item.description: Implementation of a 3-node fault-tolerant virtualization architecture featuring IOMMU hardware passthrough, local ZFS mirror pools, a 10G MikroTik spine, and decoupled power resiliency.

item.title: Intent-Based Zero Trust: Tri-Tier Remote Access & Ingress Microsegmentation
item.description: Partitioning enterprise remote access into specialized operational scopes using Pangolin IP-gating, Twingate least-privilege ZTNA, and a Tailscale travel mesh.

item.title: Two-Tier Disaster Recovery & Hardened Container Orchestration
item.description: Zero-plaintext container deployments paired with a two-tier backup pipeline utilizing local block snapshots and client-side encrypted Backblaze B2 offsite syncs.

item.title: Hybrid Cloud Perimeter: VPS Reverse-Proxy Shield & Zero-Trust ZTNA
item.description: Architecting an obfuscated edge perimeter using a stateless OVHcloud VPS, Caddy Layer 4 filtering, MaxMind GeoIP gating, and a kernel-level WireGuard transit pipe.

item.title: NOC/SOC Defense: Packet Analysis, Threat Bouncing, and SIEM Telemetry
item.description: Implementing a hybrid CrowdSec IPS and log analysis pipeline across edge proxies and hypervisors to detect, analyze, and drop malicious traffic flows.

item.title: Enterprise Multi-VLAN Network & Microsegmented Lab Architecture
item.description: A production-grade homelab architecture implementing a 6-VLAN network schema, virtualized OPNsense Layer 7 inspection, and hardened storage fabrics.

item.title: Practical Incident Triage: Analyzing Malicious Vectors and Phishing Indicators
item.description: An operational guide to analyzing weaponized email lures, header anomalies, obfuscated payloads, and building enterprise user awareness frameworks.
